# Sutton Kids Dental

> Comprehensive pediatric dentistry and orthodontic care for children from infants through young adults in Sutton, Massachusetts and surrounding communities.

Sutton Kids Dental is a specialized pediatric dental practice led by Dr. William Gordon, DMD, offering age-specific dental services, orthodontic treatments including Invisalign, and compassionate care for special needs patients across central Massachusetts locations in Sutton, Worcester, and Oxford.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Invisalign
- Braces
- Age-Based Services
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Sedation Dentistry
- Cavity Prevention
- Early Orthodontic Treatment
- Children's Dental Care
- Dr. William Gordon, DMD
- Sutton, Massachusetts
- Preventive Care
- Dental Sealants
- Invisalign Consultation

- [Dental Services for Kids in Sutton, Massachusetts](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services): Overview of pediatric dentistry and orthodontic services offered
- [Pediatric Dentistry Services in Sutton, Massachusetts](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services and preventive care for children
- [Orthodontic Treatment in Sutton, Worcester & Oxford, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/orthodontics): Orthodontic services including braces and Invisalign aligners
- [Pediatric Dentistry Treatments for Ages 0–2 in Sutton, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry/ages-0-2): Infant dental care guidance for ages 0-2 and early oral health
- [Pediatric Dentistry Treatments for Ages 3–5 in Sutton, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry/ages-3-5): Preschool dental care treatments and preventive services for ages 3-5
- [Pediatric Dentistry Treatments for Ages 6–12 in Sutton, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry/ages-6-12): School-age dental care including sealants and orthodontic guidance
- [Pediatric Dentistry for Teens & Young Adults in Sutton, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry/teens-young-adults): Dental care for teens and young adults including orthodontics
- [Pediatric Dentistry for Special Needs Patients in Sutton, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/pediatric-dentistry/special-needs-patients): Compassionate dental care for special needs patients with sedation options
- [Orthodontic Treatment for Ages 7–12 in Sutton, MA](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/orthodontics/ages-7-12): Early orthodontic treatment and guidance for children ages 7-12
- [Orthodontic Treatment for Teens in Sutton, Massachusetts](https://suttonkidsdental.com/services/orthodontics/teenagers): Teen orthodontic options comparing braces and clear aligners
